title: Trump taps ‘true warrior’ Hung Cao as Navy secretary after 4 months as acting leader
summary: Hung Cao, a retired Navy captain and special operations veteran, has led the Department of the Navy for four months as President Trump now seeks Senate confirmation.

title: Spanberger fact-checked after Trump mail-voting warning raises military ballot fears

summary: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul accused President Donald Trump of "defunding the police," saying that DHS is "withholding" millions of dollars in funding.

title: Ohio Supreme Court denies Mackenzie Shirilla's latest appeal bid in double murder case

title: Haitian college student in Ohio dies by apparent suicide after losing TPS status, family says
summary: A Haitian-born college student in Ohio died in what his family believes to be a suicide after he was stripped of his temporary protected status.

title: Hasan Piker cheerleads progressives as 80-year-old senator wins six more years

title: Washington homeowner hears mysterious banging, calls 911 before police find growling bobcat at top of stairs
